title: Journal row
description: One line of a journal file. Only external inputs and observations become rows. See docs/journal.md.

v.description: The row format version. Rows from an older v are upcast on read and never rewritten.

id.description: Unique row id. An effect's outcome is keyed by it, so a duplicate wake can't repeat the effect.

at.description: When the row was written, as an ISO 8601 UTC time with milliseconds.

kind.description: What the row records, as dotted lower-case words (docs/journal.md lists the kinds).

source.description: Where the fact came from, recorded at write time: the system that reported it and its own id for it.

session.description: The Claude-Session that wrote the row.

agent.description: The subagent within the session, if any.

item.description: The plan item the row belongs to, if any.

state.description: The item's or workflow's state when the row was written, if known.

release.description: The writer's harness release (x.y.z). A writer older than the newest row in a file is refused.

placeholder.description: Set, with the reason, on a row that stands in for missing data, so health checks can count it.
